device.type: Compact DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet, USB Wi-Fi and external IR/LED eye
device.soc: ALi M3521A / C3505 with 128 MB DDR3 (maincode "ALI_C3505:0x%x", seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (M3521A 1.1.1, 2016-7-20), maincode(AV) 0x060000 (6B000A001440, 2010-08-12, LZMA -> 11.37 MB), seecode 0x3F0000 (M3606 SEE, 2020-3-10, LZMA -> 3.54 MB), default_lang 0x51FD00 (1.0.0), cipluskey 0x51FF80 (1.1.0), countryband 0x52FF80 (1.0.0), img_webserver 0x537F80 (1.0.0), html_webserver 0x597F80 (1.0.0), logo_user 0x637F80 (1.0.0), logo_menu 0x647F80 (1.0.0), logo_radio 0x667F80 (1.0.0), logo_boot 0x687F80 (1.0.0), patch 0x6AFF80 (1.0.0), defaultdb(PRC) 0x6D0000 (1.0.1, LZMA -> 2.62 MB), userdb(64+64) 0x73FF80 (1.0.1)

source.author: Amiko / Edision
source.note: Archive AMIKO MINI HD265_v.1440.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-07.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB DDR3 C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_mini_hd265_v1440_app_starts.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, unpacks maincode(AV) ("6B000A001440", 11.37 MB) to 0x80000200 and seecode ("M3606 SEE", 3.54 MB) to 0xA6000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application drives the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 / 110 (" ON " -> " on "), populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Amiko Mini HD265 (System ID 6B000A00) Edision-themed firmware v1.4.40 (2020-03-10) for the compact Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3521A / C3505 SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.

Shares the 6B000A00 hardware platform with the Amiko HD8155: uses a "maincode(AV)" application chunk at 0x060000, a CH455 (TM1650-compatible) 4-digit LED display on GPIO 107 / 110, and the Amiko 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
